summary: Apply a supplied DICOM Spatial Registration matrix chain between original Frame-of-Reference UIDs and show illustrative paired-landmark residuals without computing or certifying registration accuracy.
objective: Apply a supplied DICOM Spatial Registration matrix chain between original Frame-of-Reference UIDs and show illustrative paired-landmark residuals without computing or certifying registration accuracy.
example_prompts: Build dicom registration landmark residual inspector with explicit provenance, laterality, frame and unavailable-state checks.
negative_signals: infer missing clinical data from geometry
not_for: Diagnosis, treatment, procedure guidance or patient-specific inference.

entities.name: Frame ledger
entities.guidance: Retain source/registered UIDs, patient-coordinate millimetres, laterality, matrix type and row-major values.

entities.name: Transform chain
entities.guidance: Display source-to-registered direction and the explicit column-vector chain Mtotal=Mn*...*M2*M1, where M1 is the first encoded item applied.

entities.name: Illustrative residuals
entities.guidance: For supplied native-frame pairs, show e_i=q_i-pi(Mtotal[p_i,1]) and ||e_i|| in millimetres; label them illustrative residuals, never TRE or clinical accuracy.

state_contract.model: Accept a finite DICOM Matrix Sequence M1..Mn, each parsed from 16 row-major values, with affine last row [0,0,0,1], original source/registered Frame-of-Reference UIDs, millimetre units and 3..100 declared source/target point pairs. For column vectors, apply the first encoded item first: p' = Mn(...M2(M1 p)), so Mtotal=Mn*...*M2*M1. Inversion must be explicit and nonsingular. For pair i compute e_i=q_i-pi(Mtotal[p_i,1]) in the registered native frame, d_i=||e_i|| millimetres and RMS=sqrt(sum d_i^2/N); these are illustrative supplied-pair residuals, not TRE or registration accuracy.
state_contract.authority: Supplied source records, identifiers, frames and curated labels own state. Blender/glTF geometry is display-only; Three.js owns validated runtime binding and exact reset.

invariants: For a matrix labeled RIGID, check only its upper 3x3 R with R^T R approximately I and det(R) approximately +1, plus affine last row [0,0,0,1]; do not test the translated 4x4 matrix itself for orthonormality.
Matrix direction and original UIDs remain visible.
Pair filtering never changes the full-set RMS readout.
Singular requested inverse, nonfinite value or UID mismatch stops.
motion_guidance: Pre/post playback evaluates the immutable source points through the supplied source-to-registered matrix chain; Blender supplies neutral axes/glyphs, glTF carries no authoritative registration transform, and Three.js parses row-major DICOM values, calls Matrix4.set with row entries, composes Mn...M1, computes residuals and resets.
creative_affordances: Use restrained cutaways, translucent planes and non-color selection cues without implying clinical confidence.
known_limits: Documentary source review only; no dataset, patient record, simulation, specialist clinical validation or runtime was used.

claims.statement: DICOM PS3.3 defines Spatial Registration as a relationship between Frames of Reference and encodes row-major 4x4 source-to-registered matrices with RIGID, RIGID_SCALE and AFFINE types; for column-vector evaluation the first Matrix Sequence item acts first, so three encoded items compose as M3(M2(M1 x)).
claims.scope: DICOM PS3.3 2026c A.39 and C.20.2; matrix presence does not establish registration quality.

source_refs.locator: A.39.1; C.20.2 Matrix Sequence and C.20.2.1.1-.2

object_craft.structure: Blender authors neutral source/registered axes and landmark glyph prototypes at identity only; export them via glTF with stable node names and never bake a patient/reference registration into mesh vertices or node transforms.
object_craft.material: Source/target shapes differ without relying on hue.
object_craft.articulation: Three.js parses each DICOM row-major matrix into Matrix4.set row entries, owns Mn*...*M1 composition, immutable native-frame points, millimetre residual arithmetic, frame labels and reset.

physical_contract.scope: Display of supplied educational or derived biomedical records; no tissue mechanics or diagnostic model.
checks: Reject ambiguous side, unit or frame.
